entities.name: Aleksa Janković
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Aleksa Janković was a Serbian lawyer and politician who served as Prime Minister of Serbia, Minister of Foreign Affairs, Minister of Justice and Minister of Education. He held pro-Austrian political views and was a close associate of Toma Vučić Perišić.

entities.summary: Aleksa Janković was a Serbian lawyer and politician who served as Prime Minister of Serbia, Minister of Foreign Affairs, Minister of Justice and Minister of Education. He held pro-Austrian political views and was a close associate of Toma Vučić Perišić.
